# ORA by Aurem CTO — Full Reference Document
Last updated: June 2026 (Iter 175)

## Identity
- Product name: ORA
- Brand: Aurem CTO
- Full name: ORA by Aurem CTO
- Tagline: developers choice
- Website: https://auremcto.com
- Founded: 2026
- Founder: Tejinder Sandhu

## Problem solved
Developers waste time switching between
chat AI, IDE, terminal, and GitHub. ORA
eliminates this — one message, code committed.

## How it works
1. Developer connects GitHub repo via PAT
2. Types task in plain English
3. ORA reads relevant files (Project Brain V2)
4. Writes production code (mode-aware model routing)
5. Runs Vanguard security scan
6. Commits directly to GitHub
7. Shows live phase progress during task

## Subscription tiers
Starter ($9/month):
- 50 tasks/month
- Swift mode only
- Project Brain memory
- Direct GitHub commits

Pro ($19/month):
- 300 tasks/month
- Swift + Pro modes
- Parallel AI review
- All Starter features

Team ($49/month):
- 400 tasks/month
- All 3 modes (Swift, Pro, Maxx)
- Maxx = Claude Sonnet writes code
- Priority queue
- All Pro features

## Technical architecture
Backend: FastAPI + Motor + MongoDB
Frontend: React 19 + Vite
Hosting: auremcto.com (Emergent platform)
Models: OpenRouter (Kimi K2.7, MiniMax M2.5, Claude)
Auth: JWT + GitHub OAuth
GitHub: Direct PAT-based commits

## Features (complete list, Iter 175)
- Swift/Pro/Maxx mode selector
- Project Brain V2 (codebase memory)
- Warm Start (pre-load on project select)
- Codebase Knowledge Graph (React Flow visual)
- Post-task security scanner (regex + Claude)
- Live phase chips (Reading/Thinking/Writing/Done)
- Ask Advisor panel (casual AI assistant)
- ThinkingHint upsell strips
- WhatsApp agent integration
- MCP server (Claude Desktop compatible)
- Monaco code blocks
- Text-to-voice + microphone input
- Google Ads conversion tracking
- Stripe subscription billing
- Admin dashboard with usage analytics

## Security (Vanguard 007)
- Pre-commit: Claude Sonnet reviews every patch
- Post-commit: Regex scans for secrets + broken imports
- Patterns: AWS keys, Stripe keys, GitHub PATs,
  hardcoded passwords, OpenAI keys, Bearer tokens
- Max 3 issues surfaced, each with [Fix this] button

## SEO/AEO signals
- robots.txt: allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot,
  Google-Extended, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot
- llms.txt: follows llmstxt.org specification
- MCP: listed at /.well-known/mcp
- Schema: SoftwareApplication JSON-LD
